semantic_label: page state load: read twenty one typed properties into the build record, take the follow block pointer and grow the node cursor to the cell count

runtime_gates: the receiver class is unresolved; the target writes only the opaque build record fields
all ten ports are dependency-only, so the twenty one property reads are unverified in this package
the follow block pointer is reinterpeted from a float bit pattern, so a fractional value produces a misaligned pointer in the original and the model reproduces the same reinterpretation
the eighteen property keys are undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation reports the cell loop as a counted for; the assembly is a do while that recomputes the cell count each pass, so the corrected model keeps the recomputation
the decompilation reads the follow block from the word at +0x3c before the quad store; the assembly stores the quad first and then reinterprets the word it just wrote, so the model keeps that order
the decompilation omits the null release check on the second list variable, which is statically null, so the corrected model keeps the guarded release and the null read is never executed

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
